propositions: rebar's ticket store push.py uses git stash operations (push/pop/drop) in a linked worktree, but the stash stack is shared across all worktrees of the repository, allowing a stash from one worktree to be popped into the tickets branch

a foreign stash from a source branch applied into the tickets worktree can leave unmerged index entries with source files that do not belong to the store, stranding the index and blocking all subsequent store writes

the auto-heal classifier for unmerged paths had only two buckets (regenerable and ticket data) and lacked a bucket for foreign source files, causing genuine non-ticket paths to wedge writes instead of being discarded
rebar must eliminate the use of git stash in the tickets worktree, replacing the stash push/merge/pop dance with a stash-create-by-sha design that does not consult the shared refs/stash stack

operators performing ad-hoc git operations directly in the tracker worktree require a supported maintenance entrypoint with backup-before-first-write, refusal on unpushed commits, and durable audit records, plus a break-glass override for genuinely unforeseen cases
